question: Who was the author of the book "Vrihat Katha Kosha'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Harisena.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct author of the book "Vrihat Katha Kosha" is Harisena.
 
• Harisena was a Sanskrit scholar and poet who lived in the 4th century CE.
 
• "Vrihat Katha Kosha" is a collection of ancient Indian folk tales and legends.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Harisena was a court poet of King Samudragupta of the **Gupta**____** **dynasty__.
 
• **Laxmidhar **was a 19th-century** Bengali author** who wrote a book with a similar name "Katha Kosha".
 
 
• Laxmidhar's "Katha Kosha" is also a collection of **ancient Indian stories.**
 
 
 
• **Rajashekhar **was a **10th-century Sanskrit poet **and **dramatist **who is known for his **plays and poems.**
